# Spec before code

Prevents: an agent inventing requirements, then defending them.

- Non-trivial work starts from `specs/REQ-NNN-<slug>/spec.md`. Copy
  `specs/000-template/`.
- Anything you had to assume becomes `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION: <question>]` in the
  spec. **Implementation may not begin while any marker remains** —
  `scripts/gates/spec-clarity.sh` fails the gate.
- `plan.md` carries the pre-implementation gates: simplicity (no speculative
  layers), anti-abstraction (use the framework directly), integration-first
  (contracts and contract tests before implementation). A deviation is allowed
  only if it is written down in the Complexity Tracking table with a reason.
- `tasks.md` marks independent tasks `[P]` so they can be fanned out to parallel
  agents or worktrees.
